name: Passive plate hotel
status_line: No controller, so nothing to decode. In PyLabRobot it is a resource: plate holders on a carrier.
reaches: Nothing to reach: no wire. Software keeps a model of what sits on each shelf (PyLabRobot resources) and the arm that loads it is the only actor. The scheduler owns reservations and timers.
decoded_from: Nothing decoded. PyLabRobot 182f92e has no hotel class; the example uses a PlateCarrier (pylabrobot/resources/carrier.py:269-331) with 24 PlateHolder sites (pylabrobot/resources/carrier.py:159-211). Assigning to a taken spot raises ValueError (pylabrobot/resources/carrier.py:79-87).
steps: Measure the shelf pitch, the first shelf height and the plate seat; put them in a PlateCarrier of PlateHolder sites.
Set pedestal_size_z for each PlateHolder; the constructor raises ValueError without it (pylabrobot/resources/carrier.py:184-189).
Place with hotel[slot] = plate and remove with hotel[slot] = None, so a taken spot raises instead of stacking (pylabrobot/resources/carrier.py:104-111).
Keep reservations and dwell timers in the scheduler, with a clock you can inject in tests.
Free a slot only after the arm confirms the pickup; an unconfirmed pickup keeps the slot reserved.
Teach the arm 1 pose per shelf and check each against the model before the first run.
scenario: Reserve shelf 5, place 1 skirted 384-well assay plate, wait a 600 s dwell on a simulated clock, pick it up, free the shelf. Sizes, pitch and dwell are made up.
real: Upstream PlateCarrier, PlateHolder and Plate classes
The ValueError raised for a taken spot
simulated: What is physically on each shelf
The arm's place and pickup confirmations
not_checked: Any physical hotel or its dimensions
limits: lost_reply maps to a pickup with no confirmation; device_error maps to placing into a taken spot (pylabrobot/resources/carrier.py:86).

Only hotel[slot] = plate refuses a taken spot. PlateHolder.assign_child_resource defaults to reassign=True (pylabrobot/resources/carrier.py:195-211), and then adds a 2nd plate with no error (pylabrobot/resources/resource_holder.py:74-76).
PlateHolder refuses non-skirted plates (pylabrobot/resources/carrier.py:209-210) and needs pedestal_size_z (pylabrobot/resources/carrier.py:184-189).
No reservations or timers in pylabrobot/resources; the scheduler in drive.py is this example's own code.
